name: gen_ai
description: Operations related to Generative AI interactions

fields.name: gen_ai.chat
fields.description: A chat interaction with a generative AI model

fields.name: gen_ai.execute_tool
fields.description: Execution of a tool or function by a generative AI model

fields.name: gen_ai.handoff
fields.description: Handoff of control between different AI agents or components

fields.name: gen_ai.invoke_agent
fields.description: Invocation of an AI agent to perform a task

fields.name: gen_ai.embeddings
fields.description: Generation of embeddings by a generative AI model

fields.name: gen_ai.generate_content
fields.description: Content generation by a generative AI model

fields.name: gen_ai.rerank
fields.description: Reranking of documents or results by a generative AI model

fields.name: gen_ai.decide
fields.description: Decision on a set of typed questions (e.g., boolean, choice, or score) about a shared state by a generative AI model

fields.name: gen_ai.evaluate
fields.description: Evaluation of typed questions (e.g., boolean, choice, or score) about a shared state by a generative AI model

fields.name: gen_ai.create_agent
fields.description: Creation of an AI agent that can later be invoked to perform a task

fields.name: gen_ai.responses
fields.description: An interaction with a generative AI model through a responses API

deprecation.note: responses is not a well-defined value for gen_ai.operation.name

fields.name: gen_ai.text_completion
fields.description: A text completion request to a generative AI model

fields.name: gen_ai.memory.client
fields.description: A memory store or memory record operation performed by a generative AI agent
